notes: Source: Wikidata property P737 (influenced by), read 2026-11-27 via the Wikidata search API and the SPARQL endpoint (read-only). 86 of 88 languages mapped; not mapped: 'm' (the only item named M, Q1537488, is Microsoft's 2008 'Oslo' modeling language, not Power Query M) and 'excel' (only Microsoft Excel the application, Q11272, exists; it has no P737 values, so it is recorded as null). Items that are software products rather than languages: bash = GNU Bash, spss, stata, tex, scratch, matlab (Q169478), mathematica (Q81294). Extra items also queried and merged into the same node: ml also Standard ML (Q597330); matlab also Q37805571; basic also BASIC (Q42979; primary is Dartmouth BASIC); delphi also Object Pascal (Q633894); mathematica also Wolfram Language (Q15241057); kq also Q (Q7265638; primary is K); algol also the generic ALGOL family item (Q188436); simula also Simula 67 (Q10371720); fortran also FORTRAN II (Q28555914). Candidates that come only from a merged or generic item say so in the comment where it matters (ALGOL -> BASIC, Icon, PL/I, Scheme; Standard ML -> Rust; Object Pascal -> Java and Smalltalk -> Object Pascal; all Mathematica candidates come from the Wolfram Language item; FORTRAN II -> SNOBOL). Mapped nodes with no P737 values at all: apl, cypher, dax, iswim, matlab, mdx, sas, spss, stata, tex, tsql, vb; their dataset ties necessarily fall under dataset_only. Wikidata P737 values outside the 88 that are close to a node but were NOT merged: Unix shell -> Perl (dataset has sh -> perl), Modula and Oberon-2 -> Go, Modula -> Lua and Modula-2, ALGOL W -> Pascal, KornShell and C shell -> Bash. P737 is uncurated and largely mirrors Wikipedia infoboxes: treat every candidate as a lead. Plausibility and comments are from the checker's own knowledge and are unverified unless a quote is given. Quotes were read on 2026-11-27 from 6 pages (Rust Reference, Go FAQ, Lattner's page, ruby-lang.org, Elixir blog, Lua history); whitespace is normalized and the Rust lines are list items. 9 pages were fetched in total (the Swift book, Kotlin FAQ and F# docs pages gave nothing usable). Sources without a quote, and all DOIs, are from memory and need checking. Counts: 331 P737 statements read, 240 distinct pairs within the 88; 103 agree with the dataset, 137 candidates (31 high, 52 medium, 54 low), 44 dataset ties not in Wikidata.
